controls.hardware: 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q, exclusive TP=2, PCIe, no NVLink, WSL2

hard_gates: visible answer and allowed finish reason
no OOM, corruption, unexplained loss, or restart
at least 3 GiB free VRAM per card for a recommended profile
exact restoration of starting serve and router state
expected_negative_gate: Two independent requests of 250000 prompt plus 8192 output exceed stable v0.1.0's 507904-token pool by 8480 tokens and rc.14's documented 499712-token pool by 16672 tokens; retain measured admission failure or reduced actual prompts rather than retrying as a startup defect.
